messages:
Miriam L: Quick PSA - a customer reported a small duplicated tail at the head of resumed SSE streams in the browser polyfill after token rotation. Looks like 3-6 bytes replayed; breaks client-side diffing.

Devon R: Polyfill vs native EventSource? Which platform reproduces?

Miriam L: Polyfill only (Chrome + iOS webviews). Native ES behaves correctly. Repro: start chat stream -> short JWT expires -> SDK refreshes token and reconnects -> resumed payload starts with the last few chars of the previous event then continues.

Sam K: Root cause seems to be parse-buffer retention + inclusive resume semantics on the server. Our polyfill keeps an unfinished buffer so if the TCP conn dies mid-chunk you still have a tail in memory. If server then replays the inclusive offset we get double-play. Node SDK clears parser state on reconnect so it avoids this.

Kevin P: Ops note: reverse proxies with low idle timeouts close connections mid-chunk in stress tests which makes this more likely. We should also consider server keepalives to reduce mid-chunk closes.

Miriam L: Current polyfill parse loop (simplified):
```
let buf = '';
es.onmessage = (ev) => {
  buf += ev.data;
  const blocks = buf.split('\n\n');
  buf = blocks.pop() || '';
  for (const b of blocks) handleEvent(b);
}
// reconnect today preserves buf
```

Devon R: Two defensive changes immediately: (1) clear the parse buffer on reconnect to avoid reprocessing an in-memory tail, (2) add a client-side dedupe keyed by event seq/offset so duplicates are ignored.

Sam K: Agreed. For long-term parity we should standardize resume semantics to exclusive offsets server-side. Additionally, we can add a tiny per-chunk checksum metadata (e.g., 8-bit rolling hash or CRC16 encoded in resume token) so client can detect overlap at a byte level if needed. That would make duplicate detection robust even if buffers survive.

Kevin P: Ops suggests server send colon-heartbeat lines ":hb\n\n" every 20s to keep proxies from killing connections. Make sure heartbeats are stripped by SDK and not counted towards billing metrics. I'll draft an nginx example tuned to proxy_read_timeout and keepalive.

Miriam L: I'll open a small PR to clear parse buffer on reconnect, add a \"resumePreference\" option (\"exclusive\"|\"inclusive\", default \"exclusive\"), and add unit tests that force-close TCP mid-chunk. I can also prototype the checksum idea as an opt-in compatibility flag.

Sam K: I'll update the resume header parity spec so both SDKs accept Last-Event-ID header and resume_token query param interchangeably. Also add client fallback behavior: if resume fails N times, switch to short polling to protect UX.

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/sse-polyfill-resume (build 8114) :rocket:

Devon R: Action items:
- Miriam: PR to clear buffer on reconnect, resumePreference opt, unit + e2e for mid-chunk close, prototype checksum flag
- Sam: spec for header/query parity, client dedupe by seq, fallback polling behavior
- Kevin: ops nginx + heartbeat recommendations and confirm keepalive not billed

Miriam L: Thanks all  will tag reviewers and attach repro traces. Closing once CI + e2e green. :white_check_mark:
